take: Mortgage rates rose this week and sit about a full point above where they were a year ago.
Price cuts are most common in the Valley and least common in Beverly Hills and the Hills. Every region is in the table.
In October, closed sales in Los Angeles County ran well below last year while the county price stayed close to flat year over year.
This is the first weekly reading. Week-over-week changes start with the next update.
